brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit (small cluster of bases)
requirements.evidence: 3 full bases at 0,0,0 + 1,0,0 + 0,1,0 forming compact L-shaped desk unit

Installed hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf at -1,1 (notch:0#-1,1#notch0) which is the drawer frame that sits between two bases; no separate drawer insert socket is currently offered by configurator for this cluster, so full sliding drawer not instantiated

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet holding small platform
requirements.evidence: Spike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 (spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0) set to mount variant with platform-sm accessory

finish.summary: Compact 3-base unit built with spike at three-base junction carrying platform-sm; drawer frame notch installed but drawer insert not offered - partial drawer.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
